concept: Branding for a made-up restaurant (Oxlip), on the things a table holds, rendered in 3D (Blender) on an olive cloth and shot from the same side three ways. The set: a cream Reserved card, a stack of coasters and a lilac matchbox, one flower mark on all three. Close on the matchbox, tray out: black tray, lilac match heads. Then the Oxlip box behind a blank white one: yours next. Olive, cream card, black ink and one lilac.
